subject: Post-call: procurement & budget owner mapping / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement path + budget owner mapping

Hi Sara / Tom 

Thanks again for the call earlier  great to get a clearer sense of Acme's use case for Redwood (search/rerank + chat for Support automation). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Requirements we heard: production throughput for ~200 req/s peak, retention 30 days, SOC2 evidence + audit log access.
- Commercial path: you mentioned Procurement typically needs an SOW + PO for anything over $50k annually; payment by PO is common.
- Marketplace: you flagged interest in buying through your internal marketplace (Acme Marketplace) if we can meet the contract requirements.

Requesting the following so we can draft the right paperwork:
1) Confirmation on whether Acme requires a Purchase Order for initial PO/commit (card vs PO).
2) Who is the budget owner / economic buyer? You mentioned Lillian in Finance on the call  can you confirm name, title, and email?
3) Any specific procurement terms (insurance limits, vendor onboarding portal link, or standard P-Card rules) we should review.

If PO is the path, it would be helpful to get your PO template (or the email for procurement@acme) so we can pre-fill fields for faster routing. If marketplace is preferred, let us know the vendor listing requirements.

I attached a short one-pager on Redwood and a template SOW to speed review.

Proposed next step: procurement kickoff with your finance + procurement owners next week. Happy to share a mutual action plan (MAP) ahead of that meeting.

Thanks  speak soon.


Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: redwood-onepager.pdf, ACME-PO-template.pdf

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T17:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement path + budget owner mapping

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the recap and the materials. Quick answers below: 

1) Payment method: For initial pilots under $25k we can pay by corporate card. Anything above that will require a PO and signatory approval from Finance.

2) Budget owner / economic buyer: Lillian Park, Sr. Finance Manager  lillian.park@acme.com. She owns the budget for Platform Ops. Tom will be the product sponsor and will drive technical sign-off.

3) Procurement terms: I attached Acme's standard PO template (ACME-PO-template.pdf). Insurance and vendor onboarding are handled by Procurement; procurement@acme.com is the intake. Our marketplace listing is possible but takes ~4–6 weeks (catalog review + security attestation).

We can do a procurement kickoff on Wednesday 5/13 at 10am PT if that works. Invite Finance and Procurement and we’ll move quickly.

Best,
Sara
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Corp

Attachments: ACME-PO-template.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@acme.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: procurement path + budget owner mapping  loop-in for PO details

Hi Procurement team / Vivek / Rishi 

Looping in our commercial ops and solutions lead to help map the internal approval flow and confirm any redlines that might block the PO path.

Vivek / Rishi  from Sara's note: Acme prefers PO for >$25k, Lillian Park (Finance) is the budget owner, Tom is the product sponsor. I attached their PO template above.

Can you: 
- Confirm whether the PO template has any fields we need to pre-fill or items that typically require negotiation (e.g., payment terms, IP clauses, limits of liability).
- Suggest an expedited checklist so Acme can route this internally in 1-2 weeks (target close: end of May).

I’ll prepare a short mutual action plan and bring proposed SOW language for their review prior to the call on Wed 5/13.

Thanks 

> On May 10, 2026, at 5:28 PM, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@acme.com> wrote:
> > (attached) ACME-PO-template.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap: procurement path + budget owner mapping  loop-in for PO details

Thanks for the context, all. Quick plan from our side: 

1) We’ll pre-fill the PO template with the following recommended values (to speed routing): vendor name, Redwood EIN, billing contact, contract term (12 months), annual committed spend estimate, payment terms (Net 30 by default).

2) Rishi will review the PO template for any legal red flags (indemnity, liability caps). Rishi  can you confirm by EOD 5/11?

3) Marissa  please send the MAP and the draft SOW before the kickoff; we’ll surface any pricing/discount options for pilot vs committed. We should also confirm if Acme wants a marketplace listing in parallel  if yes, we’ll provide the required attestation docs but note that listing takes ~4–6 weeks.

4) Ask for target close: Sara, would EoM May work if we get procurement sign-off and a PO submitted in the next 2 weeks?

I’ll own the commercial follow-up and pricing flexibility. Marissa  looping you to coordinate the call invite for 5/13 10am PT.


Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | (415) 555-0177
